changelog:
Initial release of the pdf skill – a comprehensive toolkit for manipulating and processing PDF files.

- Extracts text and tables from PDF documents using Python tools.
- Supports creating, merging, splitting, and rotating PDF files.
- Includes methods for working with PDF metadata and interactive forms.
- Offers high-quality image-to-PDF and multi-image PDF creation options.
- Provides both code-based (Python) and command-line (pdftotext, qpdf, pdftk) solutions for flexible PDF operations.
